changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE welcome_regions ALTER COLUMN type ENUM ('CIRCLE', 'RECTANGLE', 'POLYGON'); CREATE TABLE welcome_region_vertices ( region_id UUID NOT NULL, vertex_order INTEGER NOT NULL, latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (region_id, vertex_order), FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES welcome_regions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -85.0511287798066 AND 85.0511287798066), CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180), CHECK (vertex_order >= 0) );

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE application_settings ADD COLUMN tiny_topics_server_url VARCHAR(2048) DEFAULT 'http://www.tiny-topics.com:8088' NOT NULL; INSERT INTO application_settings (id) SELECT RANDOM_UUID() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM application_settings);
